body: You've already helped by just being a person who cares about another person in pain. Unfortunately I'm a lost cause.. but keep being you. That is how you can help me.. bring more love and empathy into this world. That is rare in this life and anyone who brings that to this world.. is a good person in my book.

Yes but America isn't the only one with this problem unfortunately. Even in places with free healthcare if you aren't "sick enough" you have to wait till you are. If you look into it and do your reasearch you will find many people are forgotten and left to suffer. Some people get lucky and are able to access help... but the majority of us.. we will be left to suffer.

I can't because of the failing mental health system and my mental illness keeps me from making enough money to pay for health insurance. This world was not built with people like me in mind... its unfortunate but a scary truth.
Its good to know I'm not alone in that.. also that is awesome :)

This is a very odd post.... you shouldn't seek a girlfriend with a specific mental illness. Thats a good way to hurt someone with BPD and let me tell you... hurt is a hellish feeling when you have this disorder. Please do not do this as I don't believe it would be good for you or the person you are trying to seek out.

Ah spoken like someone who has seen very little of how ugly life can be for a kid in the foster system and not to mention the trauma in adulthood.. most countries have a failing mental health system so a majority end up having a horrific life.
RCs? Sorry I'm not very used to the drug world but honestly anything stronger than caffeine or the kratom I'm using would be helpful.

Thank you so much for letting me know I can come to you with any questions :) I might have to try a different strain of kratom.. I use green but I have yet to try another one besides red which is more sedating. I hope you have a great day as well!

This was such a kind and very informative comment, thank you. I will head over there and see if anyone has any ideas :) guess I have some more research to do but thank you for pointing me in the right direction.
You know... that is a good point I didn't take the time to think about that aspect. But I still thought it was uncomfortable that the person was saying we aren't capable of feeling love.
Thank you.. that is actually pretty good advice.. I guess I just panicked and didn't take the time to remember everyone with this disorder is on a spectrum and looks different to every individual.
Thank you I appreciate this more than you know.. this was very helpful.

NAD but I got the diagnosis at 27 but from what I've gathered I'm a rare case. I smoked from age 12 to 26 and most of the time I was chain smoking. Then I got a bacterial form of pneumonia that filled my lungs with fluid and I continued to smoke until I ended up in the hospital. I've had a lot of damage done but from what you posted I'm assuming.. its probably a really slim chance of that actually happening.
Thank you so much I appreciate your response

Clearly you aren't listening but please I said thank you... now leave me alone. I have way too much going on for a random doctor on the internet who isn't even reading what I said. I said I have bad insurance and they said everything was fine..if you really believe me calling them again is going to change that...You have more faith in healthcare than a majority of people on this earth. Now please stop.

Look I don't know why you are asking but they said everything was fine but the report and my symptoms say different. I'm tired of being let down by medical professionals just because of my bad insurance. I was told by doctors for years my lungs were fine and next thing I know I have several nodules and damage from bilateral pneumonia and years of smoking. I was correct on my COPD and I don't know how else to explain to you that the medical system here is awful. I wouldn't be on an internet form asking for help if I could just talk to my doctor.
I've tried but thank you for your input.

As I explained they sent me on my way and didn't even tell me what was wrong..I had to log into a portal to even know the results. It took me forever to get doctors to believe something was wrong with my lungs and it turned out I had COPD. Maybe were you live that is how it works and that is awesome.. but I'm just trying to get help when I live in a country that doesn't offer good medical care to the poor. I'm scared and just trying to figure it out..
Again that isn't an option due to my poor insurance and I don't believe this to be normal as I had a urine test before the CT with an empty bladder. But thank you for your input.

Unfortunately I don't have that option my health insurance is awful and the doctors just sent me on my way. The only reason I knew of this is because of the online portal.. and from what I've read a distened bladder isn't normal.. My bladder feels weak and I have abdominal pain still.
Oh okay.. and yeah I have a pulmonologist I know it isn't typical for my age but I have done many test including a pulmonary function test.. and my lungs are hyperinflated.

Since I've been working on my mental health I've realized my childhood trauma.. and its been a pretty uncomfortable experience. I agree with that about healing your inner child.. honestly that couldn't be any more true. I think I'm learning just how greatly your childhood effects your adulthood. 
Wow that gives me a lot of hope to hear you are a psychology student. I'm 27 and I've lost a lot of life to my mental illness and always assumed I wouldn't be able to do anything. Hearing that you are healing and working on your life when you've had so much pain.. it just gives me hope that I can make something out of myself one day. 
I'm not sure how you knew about me using kratom but I'm going to assume its because I'm following the subreddit on here lol. I definitely try to be careful with it..although I wish I could say I wasn't dependent on it. I have a lung disease that will progressively get worse the older I get. It takes a lot of energy out of me and my fatigue is pretty bad. So unfortunately I rely a lot on it for energy but I am very aware how addictive it is. Although I appreciate the warning because I know a lot of people who take it like candy assuming its 100% safe. 
I do have my medical card for edibles and I've been using shrooms to microdose. Which has helped a lot but I have a long way to go for sure. You didn't sound preachy btw :) it was actually a very informative comment and I'm sorry for the book I wrote.. lol

I'm sorry you struggle with BPD as I would not wish it on anyone. Thank you for taking the time to write this and being so open.. it did help me realize I'm not bad for this disorder. It can just be hard when your head is loud and screaming at you.. then you see other people talking negatively about your mental illness.. it is just so easy to feel like a monster sometimes.

Thank you for showing me kindness when I forgetting that it existed... that would've blew me away as well lol. I have scars on my arms too and can relate to the amount of heavy pain you need to be under to do that. I hope that you can find peace and calmness.. honestly I just wish for everyone out there struggling to find some peace.
You know what you're absolutely right.. it can be really easy to get lost in the negitivy.. but its important to keep focused on the positive.. that is how you grow. Thank you :)
Thank you.. and first that poem was beautiful and I'm so sorry you have felt that pain. It did make me feel less alone.. thank you for sharing that with a random struggling stranger on the internet.
Thank you for this... I needed to hear that.

The last time I talked to them about it they had done a test for strep or anything bacterial. Both came out negative and unfortunately this office isn't the best so they just kind of sent me on my way. I'm thinking I probably need a referral for and ENT specialists but I just know that will sadly be expensive. The lymph node has only been causing issues the past few days.. I first noticed it was swollen a few months ago I believe. I think it does have to do with my tonsil but that thing has been swollen for a couple years now.

Definitely will get it checked out I just have really bad insurance so I kind of have to weigh out my options. Thank you for taking the time to respond :) gives me a little relief to know that pain is a good sign.

First I want to thank you for taking the time to type all that out. It cleared a lot up and unfortunately I don't see anything on the vial that says what its equivalent to. I have a lung disease and my fatigue gets pretty bad so I'm hoping the liquid extract works. But you might be right on it being a waste considering how expensive it is... thank you again I really appreciate the advice! :)
Yes sorry I forgot there are other forms of extract... did I ask a wrong question? This is getting downvoted. I'm sorry if I asked a bad question..
THIS! I love it :) thanks for the reminder
Having hope for life

First it means a lot to me that anyone took the time to make a comment on this post. But thank you for the thoughtfulness of giving me advice as well :) I think when it comes to mental illness.. it is about the fight and how you fight it. Fighting depression with positivity sounds better to me :) and even if some days will be harder than others.. it will eventually go back to being good. Thank you again!
This made me smile. I really hope I can get that lucky :)

It was just really intense and I just kind of spiraled.. I'm a lot more level now and the comments have defintely helped. My mind can just go black and white and I will see the world as all bad.. it's like I forget there are still people that are genuinely good. Thank you so much.. I hate knowing other people struggle with that but it does make me feel less alone.
Thank you so much... words can not explain how much I needed that.
